programme.desc: Elmo, Tamir, Charlie, Julia, and Cookie Monster are making self-portraits in the community garden with Kayla. Kayla guides them to look into the mirror and notice the beautiful things that make you, you! Everyone looks at themselves in the mirror and starts drawing what they see. They also learn their identity is about what you love to do. So, they add onto their self-portraits and then share their drawings with each other. Cookie Monster draws his blue fur, his googly eyes, and cookies. Charlie draws her blue eyes, curly blonde hair, tap shoes, and challah bread because it’s one of her favorite Jewish foods. Julia draws her straight hair, musical notes, paw prints, and her dog Rose. Elmo draws his red fur, orange nose, a piano, and watering a flower with Abby because being a kind neighbor is part of Elmo’s identity. Tamir draws his brown skin, coily hair, comic books, and some veggies as he loves gardening in the community garden. There are so many special things that make you, you!

programme.title: CSI S4 E13 - Suckers
programme.desc: Season 4 begins with terrific back-to-back episodes involving serial killers (\"Assume Nothing\" / \"For All Our Country\"). There's a new politically minded sheriff in town and in \"Invisible Evidence\" he's ticked off that the CSI's can't get enough evidence to convict a rapist/murderer. Also, Nick and Sara buck for the same promotion. Along the way there are plenty of quirky cases: one involving a museum robbery (\"Suckers\") and one involving a dead juror (\"Eleven Angry Jurors\"). Grissom travels to a small town with plenty of secrets to solve a murder in \"Jackpot,\" Catherine dates a younger man in \"Early Rollout,\" and Sara works a case involving a woman strikingly similar to herself in \"Butterflied.\" There's also plenty of kinkiness in \"Fur and Loathing\" and tragedy \"Bad Words.\".

programme.title: When The Love Is Gone
programme.desc: The movie is a remake of the 1983 blockbuster movie directed by Danny Zialcita entitled Nagalit ang Buwan sa Haba ng Gabi. A gripping, moving story of love lost, love gained, love betrayed, and love unbound.

programme.title: Ben Delubyo
programme.desc: After his dismissal from the police force due to insubordination, Ben (Bong Revilla, Jr.) decides to lead a quiet life as a mechanic. But just as he is beginning to enjoy his new-found peace, his hometown is beleaguered by crimes. To help contain the problems before they are blown into unimaginable proportions, a PNP general orders a police lieutenant (Charlene Gonzales) to get him back. Indeed, he returns, but this time, as a vigilante. Ironically, his most important assignment is to collar a notorious drug lord (Ronaldo Valdez) who happens to be the father of his girlfriend (Aileen Damiles). Now, Ben is torn between protecting the woman he loves or upholding the law.

programme.title: Itutumba Ka ng Tatay Ko
programme.desc: Teteng (Janno Gibbs), a single father and assistant to a film director, faces his last days due to a brain tumor. Despite his fear of confrontation, he becomes determined to protect his daughter from bullies.

programme.title: Hitman
programme.desc: Seven years after his failed assassination and murder of his family, Ben (Cesar Montano) seeks revenge on Mando (Ricky Davao), master of drug syndicate and white slavery.

programme.title: Praybeyt Benjamin
programme.desc: Vice plays the role of Benjamin Santos whose family has a long tradition of serving in the military. Conflict ensues when Lolo Benjamin (Eddie Garcia) found out that his grandson is gay.

programme.title: MIA
programme.desc: Mia Salazar (Coleen Garcia), a self-destructive, alcoholic doctor who joined the Doctor to the Barrios program to heal from the tragedy of her fiance's death meets the cheerful and nerdy forester Jay Policarpio (Edgar Allan Guzman). Together, the two will embark on a new journey.

programme.title: Finally Found Someone
programme.desc: Aprilyn who is left by his groom on the day of their wedding becomes viral online. Devastated, she meets Raffy who works at a PR agency hired by the father of the groom who will help her move on.

programme.title: Just A Stranger
programme.desc: A story of a woman and a man, half of her age being in love with each other despite the fact that they are both tied with someone else.

programme.title: Cry No Fear
programme.desc: Kaycee (Donnalyn Bartolome) and Wendy (Ella Cruz) are always at each other's throat. But when they are left alone in their house amidst a storm, with intruders trying to kill them, they have no choice but to become partners as they try to escape.

programme.title: Upline Downline
programme.desc: A young man struggling to support his family enters the world of multilevel marketing.

programme.title: Camp Sawi
programme.desc: A group of brokenhearted women end up at a resort that specializes in helping people ease their pain.

programme.title: Bahay na Pula
programme.desc: Jane (Julia Barretto) and her husband come home to an old ancestral house she inherited from her grandma. As days go by, they realize something evil is living with them in the house.

programme.title: May-December-January
programme.desc: A single mother tests her relationship with her teenage son when she starts an affair with his best friend, for whom her son also harbours feelings.

programme.title: Status: Single
programme.desc: Rufa’s character is anxious to get married after her boyfriend dumps her and all her girlfriends get married one after the other. At 30, Doris can feel her biological clock ticking.

programme.title: Operation Balikatan
programme.desc: Rodrigo is an ideal husband and a loving father but his love of country surpasses his love for his family. So when he is called for a mission, he immediately joins even if his wife is against it.

programme.title: Bilib Ako Sa'yo
programme.desc: After losing his job for nearly losing a cargo of gold bars to hold-uppers, Gatdula finds himself working as a bouncer in a night club. There, he meets and is smitten by Varga.

programme.title: Who's That Girl?
programme.desc: A one-of-a-kind romantic-comedy movie about a girl who is an alleged mistress of a business tycoon, husband to Eugene Domingo's character,and father to Luis Manzano's character.

programme.title: The Ship Show (Let Love Sail)
programme.desc: Twelve people are paired into two to compete in a reality show and be the country's next big love team.

programme.title: Pangarap Ko Ang Ibigin Ka
programme.desc: Although Rafael (Christopher de Leon) feels that he is not yet ready for another commitments, Alexis (Regine Velasquez) feels that he is the one she has been looking for.

programme.title: Amnesia Love
programme.desc: A gay guy meets an accident and gets washed up in a remote island. When he wakes up he doesn't remember anything, including his gender orientation. After developing a romance with a barrio lady, things get crazy when his boyfriend is able to locate him.

programme.title: Kaluskos
programme.desc: Amid the custody battle, Rebekah (Coleen Garcia) finds another \"Amaya\" under the bed. Wanting to start a new life with the other Amaya, Rebekah seeks to set her free. But to do that, she needs to kill the impostor.

programme.title: Miss.. Gabi Na
programme.desc: At a young age, Adora (Ynez Veneracion) lost his father to a freak vehicular accident. The early demise of their father creates a strong bond between her siblings, but the time comes when she loses her sister to a group of spoiled, drug-crazed men.

programme.title: Kid Manalo, Akin Ang Ulo Mo!
programme.desc: His name is Marco (Gardo Versoza) but people call him Kid. Some years later, he finds himself in Manila as a taxi driver. An attache case containing some five million pesos is left in his cab.

programme.title: Matalino Man Ang Matsing, Naiisahan Din!
programme.desc: Their personalities are as opposite as the two poles, and the worlds they respectively belong to be perpetually at odds. Gener (Eddie Garcia) is an accomplished policeman whose track record in solving crimes is exceptional, while Mando (Willie Revillame ) is a slick con man who has a knack at wearing disguises.

programme.title: Pakboys Takusa
programme.desc: Four playboy husbands sneak out to be with other women. But when one of them dates a girlfriend of a mafia boss, their lives are put at stake.

programme.title: War Freak
programme.desc: Jack Llamas (Cesar Montano) is a dedicated half-Chinese cop being forced to marry a woman he does not love. Liza's (Jack's girlfriend) death pushes Jack to the edge, making him extremely irritable and sometimes violent. Jack has become every inch a warfreak.

programme.title: On Vodka, Beers and Regrets
programme.desc: A washed up actress and former child star Jane Pineda (Bela Padilla), battles with love, chances and alcoholism as her career plummets to rock bottom.

programme.title: The Barker
programme.desc: Coco (Empoy Marquez), is a simple jeepney barker who falls in love with Bella (Sky Carlos). Desperate to prove himself to Bella's family, Coco puts his life on the line to save them from kidnappers.

programme.title: Through Night and Day
programme.desc: Ben and Jen's relationship is put to test as they embark on a trip of a lifetime to Jen's lifelong dream destination - Iceland.

programme.title: Anong Ganap?
programme.desc: Being in on the entertainment circle is quick and easy on PBO's Anong Ganap? Presented by the gorgeous entertainment anchor ng bayan, Phoemela Baranda.

programme.title: Ikaw Lang Ang Mahal
programme.desc: Lira (Kylie Verzosa), a prize-winning author, spends a week to finish her final novel. But when she meets Andrei (Zanjoe Marudo), a young documentarist, her plans start to change.

programme.title: Sisterakas
programme.desc: The childhoods of Bernice (Vice Ganda) \u0026 Detty (Ai-Ai Delas Alas) were world's apart, but they did have one thing in common: their father. Headed by the eccentric yet equally brilliant \u0026 talented Roselle (Kris Aquino) the competition gets tougher, and a string of events lead to the two company heads fighting over the once expendable Detty.

programme.title: Sa Huling Paghihintay
programme.desc: The first time Eric (Bernard Palanca) laid eyes on Geri (Rica Peralejo), he knew that he had met the love of his life. Little did he know that the short encounter was the beginning of a life-long delusion.

programme.title: Torotot
programme.desc: Torotot explores the story of two couples, why and how their marriages crumble and how their infidelity and passions have brought them tragic endings.

programme.title: Paloma
programme.desc: In an environment ruled by mores and conventions, is there a room where unorthodox love can bloom?

programme.title: General Emilio Aguinaldo
programme.desc: General Emilio Aguinaldo is a three-hour epic chronicling his political rise, his rivalries and his struggle against the Spanish and American colonizers. It aims to present a comprehensive narration of his life, achievements and even some controversial issues about him.

programme.title: Ikaw Lang Ang Mahal
programme.desc: Lira (Kylie Verzosa), a prize-winning author, spends a week to finish her final novel. But when she meets Andrei (Zanjoe Marudo), a young documentarist, her plans start to change.

programme.title: Anong Ganap?
programme.desc: Being in on the entertainment circle is quick and easy on PBO's Anong Ganap? Presented by the gorgeous entertainment anchor ng bayan, Phoemela Baranda.

programme.title: Working Boys 2: Choose Your Papa
programme.desc: About the bums who need to strategize in life, the roles of the three are sloppy every time they strategize. All three are natural comics so they are very natural in their roles.

programme.title: A Hard Day
programme.desc: Dingdong Dantes (Detective Edmund Villon) plays a crooked policeman involved in a hit-and-run accident. John Arcilla (Lieutenant Ace Franco) plays another officer who tries to blackmail him.

programme.title: Baler
programme.desc: Baler is primarily a love story between Feliza, the daughter of a rebel commander (Anne Curtis), and Celso, a half-Spanish soldier (Jericho Rosales), set at the twilight years of the Spanish regime in the Philippines.

programme.title: Ikaw na Sana
programme.desc: Blanca (Angelu de Leon) is a bubbly young woman with a positive view on life, but on the night she turns eighteen, a curse comes true and and destroys her face and dreams.

programme.title: Instant Daddy
programme.desc: Valentin Roxas (Jerald Napoles) raises a baby left behind in his cab as his own daughter. But his life takes a sharp turn when the birth mother resurfaces.

programme.title: Super B
programme.desc: Bi (Rufa Mae) is an ordinary girl wanting to make a difference. Lord (Marvin Agustin), Bi's long time suitor gave her a mysterious ring, which if worn by the right person can yield special powers. She soon becomes Super B, a super hero who helps the distressed.

programme.title: Linlang
programme.desc: Rich, beautiful and in love, Lance and Lyra are an ideal couple. But the end of their blissful marriage begins when Lance meets Jill. The love triangle distorts their perspectives, and ultimately, it leads to a tragic death.

programme.title: Babaylan
programme.desc: An immortal woman falls for a dashing young man, without her knowing that his ancestor was her lover in the past. They must work together to escape an insane man who's after her fountain of youth.

programme.title: Fangirl Fanboy
programme.desc: It tells the story of a wannabe actor and a talented teleserye dubber who agrees to help him improve his acting. Her coaching helps him achieve his dream of becoming a star only to find herself heartbroken when he becomes successful.

programme.title: Keka
programme.desc: Keka (Katya Santos) is a beautiful young woman working in a call centre. She hunts down the killers and avenge her boyfriend's death. Everything has been going well until she meets the guy, who makes her fall in love again.

programme.title: Bakit 'Di Mo Sabihin?
programme.desc: Deaf couple Miguel (JC De Vera) and Nat (Janine Gutierrez) learns that it is not their inability to speak or hear that tears them apart.

programme.title: Wang Fam
programme.desc: A family of aswang attempt to transition into a living a more normal, less monstrous life.

Elektra
programme.desc: Elektra, a warrior, faces a life-threatening situation, after which she decides to work as an assassin. When she is tasked to kill an innocent man and his daughter, she decides to protect them.

programme.title: Lady Bloodfight
programme.desc: Jane, an American girl travelling in Hong Kong, gets into a physical altercation with three robbers where she defends herself. A martial artist, who observes the event, trains her for a competition.

programme.title: The Giver
programme.desc: Jonas, a young man, trains under an elder in order to become the keeper of his community's memories. However, things get complicated once he discovers the sinister side of his city.

programme.title: Aliens in the Attic
programme.desc: While holidaying with their family, a group of children discover that their vacation home is riddled with aliens who intend to conquer Earth using a mind-control weapon.

programme.title: Non-Stop
programme.desc: A US air marshal receives threatening messages demanding that his airline transfer USD 150 million dollars to an offshore account, in the absence of which the passengers of his flight will be killed.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: Summer Vacation
programme.desc: On a luxury monster cruise ship, Dracula meets Ericka, the captain of the ship, and falls for her. However, he is unaware that she is part of the Van Helsing family, who want to destroy all monsters.

programme.title: Hunt to Kill
programme.desc: A gang of thugs hold captive a US Border Patrol agent and his daughter in the wilderness.

programme.title: Assassin's Creed
programme.desc: Callum Lynch learns of his ancestor Aguilar de Nerha's ties to a brotherhood of dangerous assassins. So, he travels back in time to acquire their skills and take down a corrupt organisation.

programme.title: Braven
programme.desc: A logger and his father head to their hunting cabin, hoping for a quiet weekend. Instead, they find themselves in a kill-or-be-killed stand for survival when they encounter a gang of drug traffickers.

programme.title: A Cure for Wellness
programme.desc: Lockhart travels to a mysterious wellness spa in the Swiss Alps to retrieve his company's CEO. However, he encounters strange things that make him question the spa's seemingly miraculous treatments.

programme.title: Born to Fight
programme.desc: Dan Barnes, a former professional boxer, takes up the responsibility to coach Matthew Miller, a teenager who is repeatedly bullied by a school boxing champion and his friends.

programme.title: The Starving Games
programme.desc: In a deadly game orchestrated by President Snowballs, skilled archer Kantmiss Evershot, her boyfriend Dale and tech-savvy ally Peter Malarkey must rely on their wits and skills to survive.

programme.title: Act of Valor
programme.desc: An elite team of US Navy SEALs is tasked with rescuing a kidnapped CIA operative. However, things become complicated when they come across a much larger global threat in the process.

programme.title: Sabotage
programme.desc: John Wharton, the captain of an elite task force, raids a safe house owned by one of the most lethal drug cartels with his team. Though the mission is successful, death awaits them.

programme.title: I Am Wrath
programme.desc: After corrupt cops are unable to catch his wife's killers, Stanley, an unemployed man, teams up with an old friend to avenge her death.

programme.title: Vehicle 19
programme.desc: Michael Woods, a traveller and a parolee, picks up the wrong rental car to meet his wife which makes him the prime target of a group of corrupt police officers.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
programme.desc: While playing on a cruise ship, the chipmunks and the chipettes take their pranks too far and end up stranded on a tropical island, only to discover it is not as deserted as it seems.

programme.title: And So It Goes
programme.desc: Oren is deliberately mean to the people around him. However, he is forced to change his attitude and take help from his neighbour Leah when he is asked to look after his nine-year-old granddaughter.

programme.title: Meet Dave
programme.desc: A human-shaped spaceship, controlled by 100 mini humanoid aliens, lands on earth. However, things take an unexpected turn for the small aliens when their captain falls for a woman named Gina.
